lines.trans: I have already had Unit One take over Entertainment Talk's studio.
From today on, Unit Two's staff report to Unit One's floor team.
Anyone who refuses to cooperate will be suspended at once.
Integration starts in an hour; does this plan work for you?
Here is Unit Two's performance curve since launch, including three months of ratings.
None of these numbers have been shared inside the company yet, right?
Will you read them aloud yourself, or shall I read them for you?
Then let us adjourn the meeting.
We have never done anything this bold; Lin Jie really dared to do it.
It seems Bu Xiaogu delivered the hand-signed letter.
